A trailing space inside bold: **bold** next.

Inside italic: *x* y, and strikethrough: ~~lost for~~ 13.5h.

A leading space: a **bold** word.

A space on both sides of the edge: **bold** next.

A no-break space: **a** b.

Nested marks: ***n*** x.

A mark holding only a space: x y.

A hard break at the end of a mark: **a**  
b.

A hard break at the start of a mark, after a space: a  
**b**.

A space before a hard break: a  
b.

Coloured bold: **bold** next, and underline: under next.

Link text: [see ](https://example.com)here, and [**bold** ](https://example.com)next.
